caption:
The video captures a sunlit scrubland hillside where a narrow dirt track climbs diagonally through grass tufts, low shrubs and thin bare tree trunks, with a lichen-mottled rock sitting at the center of the slope. A bright diagonal streak of sunlight cuts in from the upper left. The framing drifts slowly, nudging the rock and the left grass tuft across the view, while the surrounding vegetation shows no clear movement. Apart from this camera drift, no object clearly crosses the slope.

The most evident change is in the light artifact itself. The pale white streak swells into a strong magenta multi-ray flare that washes the upper-left of the scene, then gradually softens back toward a white diagonal beam. This shift is a lens flare rather than any object moving through the hillside, so the rock, track and plants show no physical change. As the flare recedes, the slow drift continues, leaving the composition slightly repositioned but the landscape otherwise quiet.
relations: Upper-left sunlight streak swells into a magenta multi-ray flare, then softens back to a white beam as a lens artifact.
Slow camera drift nudges the lichen-mottled rock and left grass tuft across the frame without moving scene objects.
The rock, dirt track and shrubs remain physically unchanged while the flare washes the upper-left slope.
No object crosses the slope; only the light artifact and framing shift over time.
